d_dice: Dice, darts, slot machines and other animated emoji games.
d_text: Messages that are only text (media with a caption are not text messages).
d_link: Any link to a website or Telegram. Domains on the «Allowed links» list are always allowed.
d_invite: Telegram invite links to other groups and channels (t.me/+…, t.me/joinchat/…).
d_masked: Links hidden behind text, so people can't see where they lead.
d_username: @usernames in the text (often used to advertise channels).
d_mention: Mentions of members who have no username.
d_command: /commands for other bots. Aegis's own commands always work.
d_format: Bold, italic, underlined, code and quote formatting.
d_badword: Words on the «Banned words» list. Words on the «Allowed words» list never count.
d_blocklink: Links to sites on the «Blocked links» list (also when other links are allowed).
d_emoji: Too many emoji in one message.
d_repeat: Character or word floods (“heyyyyyyy”, “buy buy buy buy”).
d_lang_fa: Messages written mostly in Persian or Arabic script.
d_lang_latin: Messages written mostly in Latin letters (English and others).
d_lang_cyrillic: Messages written mostly in Cyrillic (Russian and others).
d_lang_cjk: Messages written mostly in Chinese, Japanese or Korean.
d_forward: Forwarded messages. Sources on the «Allowed forward sources» list are always allowed.
d_via_bot: Messages sent through inline bots (@bot query).
d_as_channel: Messages members send as one of their channels. Telegram hides the person, so they can only be deleted.
d_bots: Bots added by members who are not admins: Aegis removes them. Bots on the «Allowed bots» list may be added. The punishment applies to whoever added the bot.
d_service: Telegram's notices: joined, left, pinned, title or photo changed, video chats. They are deleted (nobody is punished).
d_edit: Edited messages are deleted. (Edits are always checked against the other locks too.)
s_masked_low: only when the visible text shows a different site
s_command_low: only commands addressed to another bot (/cmd@bot)
s_repeat_low: 15 same characters or 6 same words in a row
s_repeat_medium: 10 same characters or 4 same words in a row
s_repeat_high: 6 same characters or 3 same words in a row
s_lang_medium: at least half of the letters
home_intro: Each lock catches one kind of message. Admins, Aegis and VIP-list members are never caught. Open a group to switch locks on and set them up.
window: 🆕 «New members» means joined in the last {time}.
all_off_q: Turn every lock in {title} off? Their settings are kept for when you turn them on again.
bot_cant_delete: ⚠️ Aegis doesn't have «Delete messages» here, so locks can't delete anything. Grant it in the group's admin settings.
bot_cant_restrict: ⚠️ Aegis doesn't have «Ban users» here, so locks can't mute, restrict or ban.
audit_note: 🕵️ Audit Mode is on: locks only record and report — nothing is deleted or punished.
cat_hint: 🔒 on · 🔓 off — tap a lock to set it up.
l_delete_off: 📌 The message is kept (only punished, warned or logged).
l_notice_default: 💬 Notice in the group: the standard text.
l_scope_new: 👥 Applies to: new members only (joined in the last {time}).
l_exempt: 🤝 Exempt: admins and VIPs always · trusted list: {trusted} · moderators: {mods} · {n} members by hand
allow_fwd: ℹ️ Exceptions: the «Allowed forward sources» list.
allow_gwd: ℹ️ Exceptions: the «Allowed words» list; the words come from «Banned words».
need_restrict: Mute, restrict, kick and ban need Telegram's «Ban users» right.
text_prompt: Send the notice for «{name}» (up to {max} characters). Use {user} for the member and {lock} for the lock's name. Send «-» for the standard text.
text_too_long: That's too long: at most {max} characters.
ex_hint: These members are never caught by this lock.
ex_prompt: Who should be exempt from «{name}»? Pick members with the button, forward a message from them, or send ids or known @usernames.
hits_none: Nothing caught in the last 7 days.
bots_removed: 🦾 {user} added {bots}: bots can be added only by admins, so Aegis removed them.
